driver: A total is turned into a remainder by subtracting the parts metered below it, but some metered parts sit inside other metered parts, so subtracting every listed part takes the nested ones out twice; the list holds every part at one level, and only the parts' own time series, each nested part contained in its parent and falling to zero with it, show the hierarchy.
driver_concrete: The base building's electricity is the building's import less each tenancy's supply; three tenant comms-room meters sit inside their tenancies' main meters, so subtracting every tenancy meter the register lists takes those rooms out twice and puts the base building under the loan's target, while the half-hourly registers (each room inside its tenancy's supply, both at zero when the June shutdown isolated that supply) show the nesting; the roof licensee's equipment room, named like a comms room, is a supply of its own.
stump: The default path subtracts every tenancy meter in the register from the building's import and files 15.9 kg CO2e per square metre for 2026, inside the loan's 17.6 kg target; three of those meters measure comms rooms inside their occupiers' own supply meters, so the base building's intensity is 18.5 kg and the target was missed by 0.9.
